Jonathan, saw Empeon is expanding its healthcare HCM platform with earned wage access and new APIs.

Expanding the platform usually opens more in-market healthcare providers than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Empeon off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Jonathan, quick follow-up for Empeon.

A broader platform widens the addressable market, but headcount rarely keeps pace. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to monetize the new capabilities, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Empeon needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jonathan, last bit of proof for Empeon.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Empeon's reply rate likely compares to other healthcare HCM vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
